plans.sql: EXPLAIN COSTS SELECT note FROM plan_a WHERE id=1
EXPLAIN COSTS SELECT note FROM plan_a WHERE id>0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 2
EXPLAIN COSTS SELECT a.note,SUM(b.n) FROM plan_a a JOIN plan_b b ON a.id=b.id WHERE b.n>0 GROUP BY a.note ORDER BY SUM(b.n) DESC LIMIT 2
EXPLAIN COSTS SELECT id FROM plan_a UNION ALL SELECT id FROM plan_b
EXPLAIN COSTS WITH t AS (SELECT id FROM plan_a) SELECT a.id FROM t a JOIN t b ON a.id=b.id
EXPLAIN COSTS SELECT id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY n) FROM plan_a
EXPLAIN COSTS INSERT INTO plan_a VALUES(99,99,'must not execute')
EXPLAIN COSTS UPDATE plan_pk SET note='must not execute' WHERE id=1
EXPLAIN COSTS DELETE FROM plan_pk WHERE id=1
EXPLAIN COSTS WITH t AS (SELECT id,SUM(n) AS n FROM plan_a GROUP BY id) SELECT a.id,a.n+b.n FROM t a JOIN t b ON a.id=b.id
EXPLAIN COSTS SELECT a.id FROM plan_a a JOIN (SELECT b.id FROM plan_b b JOIN plan_pk c ON b.id=c.id) bc ON a.id=bc.id
EXPLAIN COSTS SELECT a.id,x.id FROM nested_a a LEFT JOIN (SELECT b.id FROM nested_b b JOIN nested_c c ON b.id=c.id) x ON a.id=x.id
plans.setup: three colocated nonempty tables; SET disable_join_reorder=true
